bibliographic.title: Undying Gratitude
bibliographic.author: E.J. Rosa
bibliographic.description:
Here lies the story of a woman haunted by someone whose life she saved years ago. Although all the ghost does is shower her with gifts, all she wants is peace and quiet.

Written to be a modern fairytale, this piece of interactive fiction that utilizes and adapts the idea of "the grateful dead," aka Type 505 in the Aarne-Thompson-Uther Index of folklore tropes.
